title: feat: add Paid Pollen share KPI
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds the weekly Paid/Quest Pollen consumption split to `weekly_usage_stats`
- Adds a precise Paid Pollen share KPI under Revenue
- Makes the KPI available in the existing history graph explorer
- Adds focused KPI catalog coverage

Tests: `npm test -- test/kpis.test.js`; `npm run build`; production Tinybird SQL validated read-only.

After merge, deploy the Tinybird pipe to staging and production.

gist.headline: Following the Pollen Trail
gist.blurb: The hive’s ledger now separates Paid Pollen from Quest-earned Pollen each week. Polli has put on tiny accountant glasses and, regrettably, enjoys the charts.
gist.summary: Added weekly Paid-versus-Quest Pollen consumption data to the `weekly_usage_stats` Tinybird pipe, a precise Paid Pollen share KPI under Revenue, and history-graph support with KPI catalog tests.
gist.impact: Operators can now track the exact weekly share of Pollen usage funded through purchases versus Quests directly in the existing KPI explorer.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy garden ledger scene represents the new consumption split: two labeled streams of Pollen tokens, one from a small payment jar and one from a Quest scroll, flow into a retro KPI monitor showing a weekly pie chart. Polli wears tiny accountant glasses and compares the streams while code-plants and flowers grow around the terminal.
